#SPOTS v2
# Every SPOT line has one '|' separated field per key below, in this order.
# id n=table size, seat=hero seat name, stack=starting stack in bb, hand, board, hist,
# pot=chips in the middle at the decision, call=amount to call, price=call/(pot+call) in percent,
# opts, verdict=robust|close|depends, best=best option by mean, gap=best minus next option as percent of pot,
# arch=main opponent archetype breakdown, meta=generation metadata.
# hist: one '/' separated group per street reached (preflop first, the decision street last, possibly empty),
#   actions comma separated as SEAT:code,
#   code = f fold, x check, c call, b<to> bet to amount, r<to> raise to amount (street totals, bb).
# opts: ';' separated label:ev_bb:ev_pct_pot:best_share (share of table weight where that option is best).
# arch: ';' separated name:weight:best_option.
# meta: tables=tables pooled, turns/rivers=runouts sampled, ess=per-seat effective sample size range,
#   agree=best+verdict (two independent halves agree on both), pool_match=1 if the pooled result equals the halves.
# Library version 3: same line format as v2; opponents are a 50/50 per-table mixture of two invented populations (see #meta population).
